description: This script generates and writes a catalog of openclaw extension channels by scanning extension directories for package.json files, extracting metadata, and producing a sorted catalog JSON file.

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Checks if a value is a non-null object and not an array.

methods.name: trimString
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a string, or returns an empty string if the input is not a string.

methods.name: toCatalogInstall
methods.description: Creates a normalized install object with npmSpec and defaultChoice based on input data.

methods.name: buildCatalogEntry
methods.description: Constructs a catalog entry object from a package.json object if valid.

methods.name: buildOfficialChannelCatalog
methods.description: Scans extension directories for package.json files, builds catalog entries, sorts them, and returns the catalog object.

methods.name: writeOfficialChannelCatalog
methods.description: Builds the catalog and writes it to the designated JSON file if the script is run directly.
